title: version and infra usage name the project, not bin/devbin (K8)
body:
## What happens

`version` and `infra`, with every `infra.d` child (`init`, `mail`, `mail dmarc`, `profiles`), print `$DEVBIN_NAME` in their usage lines and their `try: ... --help` refusals. Every other built-in prints `${DEVBIN_INVOKE:-bin/devbin}`.

`$DEVBIN_NAME` is the project's name. It named a command only while each estate had a launcher of that name, and those launchers are retired, so in an estate these lines tell the reader to type a command that does not exist. For example, in a project named `demo`, `version`'s usage reads `usage: demo version ...`. Inside devbin the two spellings coincide, so nothing here could tell them apart. This was finding K8 in the 2026-09-21 doc audit.

## Ruling

hv: "FIX K8" (via vc, 2026-09-21). usage-rules.md already states the rule: keep `DEVBIN_NAME` for the project's identity and `DEVBIN_INVOKE` for what you type.

## Fix

Every usage line and `try:` hint in lib/cmd/version, lib/cmd/infra and lib/cmd/infra.d/* names `${DEVBIN_INVOKE:-bin/devbin}`. `$DEVBIN_NAME` stays the diagnostic prefix `die` and `warn` print. lib/cmd/infra's comment block, which explained the 2026-09-07 choice, now records this one.

## Contract

ST0003 AC-1.9 read: "Every message names the ESTATE's dispatcher rather than the literal devbin." hv's ruling supersedes that pin. It is restated as: every message names how the dispatcher is invoked, `${DEVBIN_INVOKE:-bin/devbin}`, as every other built-in does, never the project's name or the literal `devbin`. AT-1.9's arms in tests/unit/infra-profile.bats are restated to match.

## Tests (red first)

- infra-profile.bats (AT-1.9): usage and the unknown-verb refusal name DEVBIN_INVOKE, not DEVBIN_NAME. With DEVBIN_INVOKE unset, usage says `bin/devbin`. Every infra.d child's usage and refusals name DEVBIN_INVOKE.
- version.bats: the usage line reads `usage: bin/devbin version`, never `usage: demo version`.


## Resolution

Fixed at `96ec3db`, the new arms driven red first at its parent. Reviewed by vc with mutants in scratch copies: `$DEVBIN_NAME` restored in the dmarc try:, profiles usage or init usage kills the infra.d child arm; restored in version's usage kills version.bats' arm. Dropping infra's `:-bin/devbin` alone survives as an equivalent mutant (lib/helpers:136 defaults DEVBIN_INVOKE); dropping both kills the fallback arm. ST0003 AC-1.9 restated in the same commit. Full suite 1585/1585 at `96ec3db`, 0 not ok, 3 machine-bound skips as at 0.1.4 (tmp/test/20260921-2100.bats.*), run with no GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS in the environment. Ships in 0.1.5.
